title: Swimmers in Mountain River, Rocky Bank Canyon - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical amateur snapshot capturing people enjoying a sunny day at a natural swimming hole or river canyon. In the foreground, two individuals swim across the dark surface of the water, while on the rocky bank in the midground, several other figures in vintage swimwear stand and rest. The steep hillside in the background is dotted with arid brush and evergreen trees. The reverse shows ink album adhesion marks at the corners and a small stamped alphanumeric code.
